people.name: Pierre Sonnerat
people.note: Author of travel accounts on India and China; painter and observer of South Indian customs and religion.

people.name: Heinrich Roth
people.note: Jesuit missionary who travelled between Goa and Agra from 1650 to 1660 and studied Sanskrit.

people.name: Johannes Ernst Hanxleden
people.note: Jesuit missionary in Malabar from 1699 to 1732; author of an early Sanskrit grammar and dictionary.

people.name: Paulinus a Sancto Bartholomaeo
people.note: Carmelite missionary (birth name J. Ph. Wesdin) in Malabar (1776–1789) and Rome; author of early printed Sanskrit grammars.

people.name: Nathaniel Brassey Halhed
people.note: Official of the East India Company, translator of the Code of Gentoo Laws and author of a Bengali grammar.

people.name: Henricus van Rheede tot Drakestein
people.note: Dutch Governor of Malabar; author/editor of Hortus Indicus Malabaricus.
